sentence: This project studies how forest management and disturbance affect water resources, carbon storage, and forest health in forests and woodland watersheds.
This project builds a shared computing center that helps scientists use data science and artificial intelligence tools in their research.
This project builds computer methods to study how light and the vibrations of atoms act together in thin materials and in defects.
This project tries to find out how oxygen reaching T cells through soft materials changes how well the cells grow and respond.
This project uses mathematical proofs to show when software tricks for comparing genomes work, and applies them to RNA levels in a cell.
This project builds tools that use light to study electric oscillations in thin layered materials called dihalides.
This project builds simple models of text to understand how large language models learn and why they work well on many tasks.
This project builds very thin oxide layers with atomic control to make memristors whose properties can be tuned, and tests how they behave.
This project designs computer systems built from separate hardware parts that are put together as needed, and works to keep them secure and fast.
This project carries out research in materials chemistry and biochemistry, including drug delivery, energy storage, and water purification.
This project studies the nutrition of protein sources, how processing changes plant-based foods, and how chemical analysis can check food safety.
This project tries to find out how switching on genes with CRISPR changes the way stem cells behave and develop.
This project builds a way to learn the rules that decide what users may access in web applications, by watching how the applications respond.
This project builds health monitoring systems that use radio tags as wearable sensors and machine learning to track breathing and heartbeat.
This project studies how selection during the earliest stages of plant reproduction shapes which genetic traits get passed on to offspring.
This project studies how many quantum particles together form unusual states of matter, using ideas from condensed matter physics and quantum information.
This project builds an imaging method that tracks a protein as it binds membranes and forms clumps in living neurons.
This project builds a semiconductor laser that gives high power and high speed while keeping a single mode of light.
